site_text: Laurel Run is a family-owned Pennsylvania manufacturer of utility, enclosed cargo, and equipment trailers, sold through independent dealers. Skip to content Fictional company website · Created for discovery testing LR LAUREL RUN TRAILER WORKS • PENNSYLVANIA Family-owned since 1988 Menu ☰ Home Trailers Owners Information Find a dealer Contact us → Family-owned. Pennsylvania built. Since 1988. Trailers built for the work ahead Pennsylvania trailer manufacturing Welcome to Laurel Run Trailer Works From our shop in Hollow Glen, Pennsylvania, we build utility, enclosed cargo, and equipment trailers for work on the road and at the job site. Our family started Laurel Run in 1988 with a simple idea: make useful equipment and stand behind the people who use it. Today our team cuts, welds, paints, assembles, and checks trailers for a network of independent dealers. Each dealer can help you choose a model, discuss options, and arrange a purchase. Our story → Ready for the next job? Have a trailer in mind? Explore the lineup, then connect with an independent dealer. Explore our trailers → Made for the way you work Find your trailer From open utility trailers to enclosed cargo and equipment haulers, start with the style that fits your work. Open utility Trailfield A versatile open deck and rear loading gate for everyday hauling. View trailer → Enclosed cargo Enclosure Covered room for tools and materials, built around a steel frame. View trailer → Equipment Workspan A wider open deck with loading ramps for equipment and materials. View trailer → People you can talk to Find an independent dealer Laurel Run works with approximately 80 independent dealers. Dealers provide local product information, discuss available configurations, set retail prices, and handle purchases. We do not sell trailers directly from the factory to retail customers. Find a dealer → 80 + Independent dealer network Browse our fictional network by state. Browse dealer locations → Made with care Built from the frame up Our shop brings together steel frames, exterior panels, wiring, running gear, and finishing work. We check each trailer before it leaves the facility, with attention to the model and options ordered by the dealer. Ask your dealer for the specifications, load label, and available options for the finished unit.
